notes:
Improves the GitHub self-update dialog.

The initial update prompt now shows only the available version and no longer includes Release Notes.

Release Notes are still shown once after a successful update.

Adds the official website logo as the menu thumbnail for Adult-TV-Channels.com.

Adult-TV-Channels.click and FuckFlix.click remain without embedded thumbnails for now so they can later use a dedicated GitHub thumbnails folder.

Streaming logic is unchanged from v1.77-v1.80.

This is an experimental pre-release and may contain bugs or incomplete features.
